title: Website Development
menuDescription: Websites and web applications, from frontend screens to backend APIs.
summary: Build a new website or application, or add features to the one you have.

overview.title: Develop your website or web application.
paragraphs: We build the screens, backend logic, and integrations your application needs. You'll review working features as development progresses.
We document setup and deployment so your team knows how to run the code and release changes.

features.title: Practical architecture
features.description: A project structure chosen for the product, team, and expected operating needs.

features.title: Responsive frontend
features.description: Accessible interfaces engineered for real content, devices, and interaction states.

features.title: Backend and API work
features.description: Business logic, data access, and integrations built behind clear contracts.

features.title: Quality controls
features.description: Check important features in supported browsers, including loading and error states.

features.title: Performance foundations
features.description: Asset, rendering, and delivery choices made with user-perceived speed in mind.

features.title: Release support
features.description: Environment setup, deployment coordination, and a clear handover for ongoing ownership.

banner.title: What do you need your application to do?
banner.description: Share the requirements you have and tell us about any existing code or designs.

faqs.question: Which technologies do you use?
faqs.answer: We commonly work with React, Vue, Nuxt, TypeScript, Node.js, Django, Python, and relational databases. For an existing application, we start by reviewing the tools your team already uses.

faqs.question: Can you work with an existing codebase?
faqs.answer: Yes. We begin with a focused technical review to understand the current architecture, risks, conventions, and safe boundaries for change.

faqs.question: Do we need completed designs first?
faqs.answer: No. We can include product and interface design, work from your existing design system, or collaborate with your design partner.

faqs.question: Who owns the source code?
faqs.answer: Ownership and repository access are defined in the project agreement. Our normal delivery model is built around clear client access and a documented handover.

faqs.question: Can you continue after launch?
faqs.answer: Yes. Ongoing improvements and technical support can be scoped separately based on release cadence and the level of operational coverage required.
